description: This file contains reusable CSS snippets (mixins) and utility classes written in LESS for developing styles efficiently in a web project. It includes mixins for layout utilities, font styles, grid systems, form states, CSS3 properties, backgrounds, gradients, and component styling such as popover arrows.

classes.name: clearfix
classes.description: Utility class to clear floats, ensures container expands to contain floated elements.

classes.name: tab-focus
classes.description: Mixin for styling focus outlines, including Webkit-specific styles.

classes.name: center-block
classes.description: Centers a block-level element using automatic margins.

classes.name: ie7-inline-block
classes.description: Hack for IE7 inline-block display.

classes.name: ie7-restore-left-whitespace
classes.description: Mixin to restore whitespace on the left side in IE7 for inline-block elements.

classes.name: ie7-restore-right-whitespace
classes.description: Mixin to restore whitespace on the right side in IE7 for inline-block elements.

classes.name: size
classes.description: Sets width and height with default values.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Creates a square with equal width and height.

classes.name: placeholder
classes.description: Mixin to style placeholder text in input fields.

classes.name: text-overflow
classes.description: Applies text-overflow styles with ellipsis.

classes.name: font
classes.description: Namespace for font family and shorthand mixins.

classes.name: serif
classes.description: Set serif font family.

classes.name: sans-serif
classes.description: Set sans-serif font family.

classes.name: monospace
classes.description: Set monospace font family.

classes.name: shorthand
classes.description: Define font size, weight, and line height.

classes.name: gridSystem
classes.description: Namespace for grid layout system mixins and classes.

classes.name: columns
classes.description: Defines column widths based on gutter, column width, and total columns.

classes.name: offset
classes.description: Creates offsets in grid columns.

classes.name: gridColumn
classes.description: Defines individual grid column styles.

classes.name: generate
classes.description: Generates grid column classes and their styles.

classes.name: fluidGridSystem
classes.description: Namespace for fluid grid layout mixins and classes.

classes.name: inputColumns
classes.description: Defines input field widths within grid layout.

classes.name: makeRow
classes.description: Creates a grid row with proper margins and clearfix.

classes.name: makeColumn
classes.description: Creates a grid column with specified width.

classes.name: formFieldState
classes.description: Mixin for form element styling states.

classes.description: Applies border-radius with vendor prefixes.

classes.description: Applies box-shadow with vendor prefixes.

classes.name: box-sizing
classes.description: Set box-sizing property.
